description: Start here for an unfamiliar repository or a general test-architecture review. Detect and audit all project roots once, then return a bounded deterministic review: summary counts, blockers, top findings, the top-ranked candidates and plan items with execution hints, verification commands, and stats. limit caps the ranked lists (default 25) and per-test evidence is reduced to counts, so the result stays small on large monorepos. Use explain_target with repoRoot and projectRoot for one target's evidence, and analyze_repository only when the complete bundle is explicitly needed.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before the review.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.

limit.description: Maximum ranked candidates and plan items to return. Defaults to 25.

swiftSchemes.description: Optional shared Xcode scheme per Swift project root. Keys are detected project roots.

name: review_repository

outputSchema.description: Top-level shape of this artifact. The complete contract is schemas/repository-review-v1.schema.json in the published package.

title: Review Repository
